notes.title: Karpatia Update 2024
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Gamers![/b]
In honor of the Ukrainian Games Festival, we’ve updated our teaser to give you a glimpse into our story and a quick look at the gameplay.

[b]Story[/b]
Your character’s younger brother has mysteriously vanished, leaving behind a series of strange drawings. These sketches depict an old castle, now a closed museum, notorious for its eerie legends. The most chilling of them — the disappearance of hundreds of children in a single night over a century ago.
The game’s atmosphere balances between psychological horror, filled with an uncanny and unsettling mood, and a nostalgic longing for the innocence and charm of childhood.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
One of our standout features is best experienced visually
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2395520/extras/gate_03.gif?t=1724159455[/img]
The game will feature numerous meditative, visually stunning puzzles where you’ll need to match drawings and photos with reality to alter the world around you. The castle is full of secrets, and exploration is our key focus.

[b]Updates and Future Plans[/b]
Over the past year, we’ve expanded our team, implemented drawing features, finalized the story, and made significant progress on modeling a large portion of the castle. We’re about halfway there, and in the coming year, we’ll continue to work hard to deliver the best experience possible.
Our release date is now set for late 2025. In the next few months, we’ll start focusing more on marketing and communication to keep our beloved audience up-to-date. 😊
Stay tuned, and thank you all for your continued interest in our game!
